scopeChangeReason: CORRECTED CONTRACT (2026-08-12). The original contract was auto-derived by scope_contract_init_from_plan from the per-item checklist Files declarations, which listed ~21 specific files. That was an accurate description of CHK-001..CHK-005 but became wrong the moment the user corrected the freeze criterion mid-DEV and CHK-006 was added: under the corrected rule ('anything with no effect on the past evidence chain must be refactored, including filenames, documentation and code'), the rename's true surface is the whole product source tree plus all active docs and host adapters - measured at 217 paths, 398 of them under packages/main/src alone. Acknowledging 217 paths one by one would record the contract as 217 separate exceptions rather than as what it actually is: a scope the user deliberately widened. So the allow-set is restated as directory globs matching the real surface. Crucially the PROTECTED set is unchanged and still enforced - .lattice/story/** (391 frozen archives), CHANGELOG.md and CITATION.cff remain blocked, which is the invariant that carries the user's past-vs-future rule. Verified still holding at this commit: CHANGELOG.md byte-unchanged, no foreign story archive touched, all 13 signature salt literals byte-unchanged, root npm test REAL_EXIT=0 with 0 failure lines.

acknowledgements.reason: Necessary transitive closure of the brand rename, in four groups, none of which could be foreseen at PLAN time because the scope contract was derived from checklist Files declarations before the rename surface was fully measured. (1) packages/utils/src/handlers/{aux-doc,auxiliary,tool-status,truth}.ts - user-facing runtime strings that instructed the OLD bin name; leaving them would ship a CLI that teaches lattice while its docs say proof-or-stop, and packages/utils/src is now a gated brand-check root so they would also fail the gate. (2) packages/main/tests/{b90d6-init-dispatch-guidance,milestone-status}.test.mjs and scripts/verify-{codex-assets,global-lab-entrypoint}.mjs - assertions that PINNED the old brand literals; each was repinned to the new expected value, never deleted or weakened, because a rename that passes only by disabling its own assertions is not a rename. (3) scripts/verify-brand-gate-negative.mjs and scripts/verify-done-suite-green.mjs - NEW verifiers created because the DEV->REVIEW gate correctly REFUSED two non-mechanical attestations; they turn 'the brand gate bites' and 'the DONE suite is green' into executable receipts. (4) These additions are why the gate now has mechanical evidence instead of prose. All 13 signature salts, CHANGELOG.md and every foreign story archive remain byte-unchanged; root npm test is green (REAL_EXIT=0, 0 failure lines).

Two small, mechanically necessary side-effects of work already in scope, both verified by reading the diff. (1) packages/main/package-lock.json - 2 lines, the CLI patch version bump 0.3.251 -> 0.3.252 that CLAUDE.md's version discipline REQUIRES for any story changing runtime behaviour; the sibling package.json was declared in the contract but the lockfile was not, which is a declaration oversight rather than a scope expansion. (2) packages/main/smoke-manifest.json - 3 added lines registering the NEW 'audit-scan-bin-token' regression smoke, which is the test that proves the docs-drift extractor did not go vacuously blind after the rename (the highest-severity risk found in adversarial review). Registering it is what puts it in the npm test chain; leaving it unregistered would mean the regression test exists but never runs. Neither file touches a protected path: .lattice/story/**, CHANGELOG.md and CITATION.cff remain byte-unchanged.
